verdict.rationale: Airweave is built to ingest non-conversational data. It connects to apps, databases, and documents and turns them into searchable knowledge (airweave-docs-24, airweave-docs-12). Source connections automatically sync that data (airweave-docs-2), and specific connectors cover Airtable records and attachments (airweave-docs-32) and code files (airweave-docs-33). A community user confirms it copies the data into its own retrieval index (airweave-comm-2). Ingestion runs through connectors and syncs, with custom connectors as the extension path (airweave-docs-16). missing for 10: explicit support for ingesting raw JSON payloads, a documented direct upload or push API for arbitrary documents outside connectors, and hands-on corroboration of ingesting diverse document types.
